ui_bugs.issue: Button [data-testid=btn-manage-goals] renders as type='submit' (shadcn <Button> default). Playwright's real pointer click on it causes an unexpected side-effect: the Nova venda / sale-form-dialog opens instead of (or in addition to) the goals-dialog. Programmatic element.click() correctly opens only the goals-dialog. Real users clicking fast may also observe the sale form opening. Should set type='button' explicitly on the Button (and on any shadcn Button that is not a form submit).

action_items: In /app/frontend/src/components/GoalsCard.jsx line 19 (and any other shadcn <Button> used for toggles/triggers), add explicit type="button" so the browser doesn't treat clicks as form submits. This resolves the Playwright-click side effect where sale-form-dialog opens when clicking 'Gerenciar'.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew to 1529 lines across auth/sales/clients/goals/attachments/export/import — still a monolith. Carrying forward prior iteration recommendation to split into routers.

/api/clients iterates all sales for the user with no pagination. OK for current data (~20 sales), but once historical data grows, aggregate in Mongo ($group by client_name_lower) to avoid loading entire scope into memory.

/api/clients deduplicates by lowercased name only. If two different real clients share a name, their purchases will merge; and if phone/email differ across sales for the same name, only the FIRST non-empty value is kept. Consider also keying by (name_lower, phone) and/or returning all phone/email variants.

GoalCreate uses raw str for scope/metric. Pydantic Literal types (Literal['company','broker'], Literal['vgv','count']) would return 422 at the parser layer and keep manual 400 branches only for business rules (owner_id, target>0).

goal_progress recomputes _partner_share and iterates all sales for every goal on every GET /api/goals. For a few goals this is fine, but if the master defines many goals this is O(goals*sales). Consider computing company & per-broker totals once then applying to goals.

Clients datalist uses <option value=clientName/> without id, phone, or any disambiguation. Prefill works only on exact-name match (case-insensitive). If a user types a partial match and then blurs, no prefill happens. Acceptable UX; documented.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of clients + goals + autocomplete flows under test

rca of the issue: GoalsCard 'Gerenciar' button inherits HTMLButton default type='submit' because the shadcn <Button> wrapper from Dashboard doesn't pass type='button'. Although there is no explicit <form> wrapping the GoalsCard, the browser's event bubbling + React synthetic events on the live page cause the button click to also trigger the Dashboard-level 'Nova venda' handler. Programmatic .click() avoids the native event pathway and only invokes React's onClick (opens goals-dialog as intended). Fix: add type="button" to the Button in /app/frontend/src/components/GoalsCard.jsx line 19 (and audit any other non-submit shadcn Buttons across the codebase).
